pages.title: Difficulty Gift
pages.text: $(bold)Max Level:$(r) I$(br2)$(bold)Applicable:$(r) Weapons, Armor$(br2)$(bold)Effect:$(r) Stronger bonuses on higher difficulty: weapons gain damage and attack speed; armor gains armor, toughness, and max HP.$(br2)$(bold)Obtainment:$(r) Enchanting Table, Structure Chests, Villager Trades.
